_note: synonyms: another name for a drug already in the vocabulary. estimated: drugs with no interaction records of their own; checks borrow the records of a close relative and are always labelled as estimates. Curated, clinician review recommended.

Gliclazide.reason: Both are sulfonylureas; their interaction profile is largely shared across the class.

Carbimazole.reason: Carbimazole is converted to methimazole in the body, which is the active drug.

Vildagliptin.reason: Both are DPP-4 inhibitors with a largely shared interaction profile.

Teneligliptin.reason: Both are DPP-4 inhibitors with a largely shared interaction profile.

Voglibose.reason: Both are alpha-glucosidase inhibitors with a largely shared interaction profile.

Candesartan.reason: Both are angiotensin receptor blockers; class interactions (potassium, lithium, kidney function) are shared.

Cilnidipine.reason: Both are dihydropyridine calcium-channel blockers with a largely shared interaction profile.

Acenocoumarol.reason: Both are coumarin anticoagulants; bleeding and INR interactions are largely shared.

Etoricoxib.reason: Both are COX-2 selective NSAIDs with a largely shared interaction profile.

Aceclofenac.reason: Aceclofenac is partly converted to diclofenac in the body; NSAID interactions are shared.

Ornidazole.reason: Both are nitroimidazoles; alcohol and warfarin interactions are largely shared.

Teicoplanin.reason: Both are glycopeptide antibiotics; kidney and hearing toxicity interactions are largely shared.
